U64.description: 十进制uint64字符串，解析器还须检查<=18446744073709551615，不得经浮点转换。

ui_restart_count.description: Supervisor cumulative reserved UI restart attempts; null when no trustworthy current observation.

observed_age_ms.description: Age at the source sampled_mono_ms, not send time; preserve both through queues. Fresh completed-loop sample uses zero; unknown uses uint32 max.

public_routes.summary: 登录；每账号/来源每分钟最多5次失败，禁止记录凭据。
撤销当前会话；不存在/已撤销也返回204，不改变任何借还。
一致视图；普通用户仅见本人操作和借用；其他工具只见可用性。
原子占位；201仅表示REQUESTED已提交。
仅WAIT_CONFIRM；用户本人确认，不能传actor_id或成功状态。
REQUESTED可取消；可能已动作则进入REVIEW_REQUIRED。
人工核验留原因；必须匹配原类型/用户和明确的闭门/物品状态。
不能停用/降权最后管理员；停用撤销会话而不删除借用。
只列30秒内实时观测的脱敏卡信息；历史补传不参与绑定。
Bearer在握手头；只推失效提示，无命令通道，不在URL携带token。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_submit
internal_interfaces.semantics: 复制入有界队列；receipt含request/operation关联，排队不表示业务或物理完成。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_wait_result
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t locker_core_wait_result(locker_core_t *core, const locker_uuid_t *submission_token, uint32_t timeout_ms, locker_query_result_t *result);
internal_interfaces.semantics: HTTP/IPC按Core生成的内部submission_token最多等待1000ms；不按客户端request_id寻址。超时不取消，复用原幂等键。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_apply_device_event
internal_interfaces.semantics: 事件键去重后在业务线程应用；补传不能产生柜前证明。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_apply_device_reply
internal_interfaces.semantics: 设备适配器提交已解码HELLO/快照/命令结果/水位/健康响应；拷贝入队并按request/session匹配，不能用DEVICE_EVENT替代响应。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_tick
internal_interfaces.semantics: 推进业务超时与真实核心进度，不等待外设。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_query
internal_interfaces.semantics: Bounded HTTP/IPC wrapper: enqueue to Core, use private submission_token and wait <=1000ms; never read mutable domain or repository on caller thread.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_repo_commit_change
internal_interfaces.semantics: 操作+outbox+幂等+revision同一事务；仅业务线程调用。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_repo_import_events
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t locker_repo_import_events(locker_repo_t *repo, const locker_event_batch_t *batch, const locker_change_t *projection_change, locker_event_key_t *committed_cursor);
internal_interfaces.semantics: 新事件去重、可选投影变更和连续游标同事务；投影由Core构造，不由Repo猜业务。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_repo_load_recovery
internal_interfaces.semantics: 按集合/页恢复；结果DTO字段由internal-data.schema.json固定，不一次加载无限历史。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_open
internal_interfaces.semantics: 真实串口或显式模拟字节流；创建新会话并禁止新动作直至核对。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_get_snapshot
internal_interfaces.semantics: 异步取得持久化屏障快照。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_execute_once
internal_interfaces.semantics: 每物理command一次发送，超时查询，禁止自动重发。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_query_command
internal_interfaces.semantics: 无副作用结果查询；未知不是未执行。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_fetch_events
internal_interfaces.semantics: limit<=4，返回连续范围和缺口。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_ack_persisted
internal_interfaces.semantics: 只能确认RK已提交的连续水位。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_resume_ready
internal_interfaces.semantics: 对物理版本、日志epoch和水位比较；不是无条件ARM。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_release_context
internal_interfaces.semantics: 仅释放匹配的闭门上下文，不开锁、不改借用。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_send_health
internal_interfaces.semantics: 携带真实实例/进度/年龄，适配器不得代增进度。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_events_try_publish
internal_interfaces.semantics: 有界非阻塞；满则客户端重新同步。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_local_presence_submit
internal_interfaces.semantics: 私有SO_PEERCRED+登录会话+owner+revision；不能从HTTP调用。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_supervisor_report_progress
internal_interfaces.semantics: 只接受service/UI可信peer的真实循环进度。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_supervisor_request_ui_restart
internal_interfaces.semantics: 固定UI目标，限次冷却，无shell与锁动作。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_control_submit_unlock
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t mcu_control_submit_unlock(mcu_control_t *control, const mcu_request_context_t *request, const locker_unlock_intent_t *intent);
internal_interfaces.semantics: 排队->检查->异步提交意图->再检查->硬件定时脉冲。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_control_observe_inputs
internal_interfaces.semantics: 去抖、UNKNOWN、物理版本和连续性；实际电平由BSP转换。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_control_on_journal_result
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t mcu_control_on_journal_result(mcu_control_t *control, uint32_t token, locker_status_t result, const mcu_journal_state_t *state);
internal_interfaces.semantics: 只有提交成功且2000ms准备期限内、guard仍成立才能驱动。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_control_make_snapshot
internal_interfaces.semantics: 捕获物理状态并等待此前事件提交，异步回屏障。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_control_release_context
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t mcu_control_release_context(mcu_control_t *control, const mcu_request_context_t *request, const locker_context_guard_t *guard);
internal_interfaces.semantics: 闭门、无脉冲、context/revision匹配才释放。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_journal_append
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t mcu_journal_append(mcu_journal_t *journal, const locker_device_event_t *event, uint32_t token);
internal_interfaces.semantics: 复制入队；完成通过token回执；队列满锁定连续性故障。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_journal_commit_intent
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t mcu_journal_commit_intent(mcu_journal_t *journal, const locker_unlock_intent_t *intent, uint32_t token);
internal_interfaces.semantics: 意图、水位、上下文作为同一持久化检查点提交。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_journal_read_page
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t mcu_journal_read_page(mcu_journal_t *journal, const locker_event_key_t *after, uint8_t limit, locker_event_batch_t *result);
internal_interfaces.semantics: 返回最多4条和边界，不能伪造连续性。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_journal_ack
internal_interfaces.semantics: 推进已确认水位，保留未决动作检查点。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_board_read_inputs
internal_interfaces.semantics: 非阻塞规范化读数；未配置或不稳定返回UNKNOWN。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_board_start_bounded_pulse
internal_interfaces.semantics: 仅Control调用；硬件截止<=1000ms且不超过锁实际允许值。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_board_force_off
internal_interfaces.semantics: 复位/异常优先关断；不等待文件系统或串口。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_board_spi_transfer
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t mcu_board_spi_transfer(uint8_t chip_select, const uint8_t *tx, uint8_t *rx, uint16_t length, uint32_t timeout_us);
internal_interfaces.semantics: 仅PeripheralStorage；有限长度/时间，不把结构体作为wire。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_health_report_progress
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t mcu_health_report_progress(mcu_health_t *health, uint8_t task_id, uint64_t progress);
internal_interfaces.semantics: 任务真实进度，不能只观察定时中断。

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_health_evaluate
internal_interfaces.semantics: 只在本地关键任务健康时允许喂狗；主机离线本身不停止记录。

internal_interfaces.name: locker_repo_open
internal_interfaces.semantics: Schema-checked open; failure sets out to NULL; never clear corruption.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_repo_query
internal_interfaces.semantics: Typed RepositoryQuery/Result; core-thread-only; byte-bounded pagination.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_repo_close
internal_interfaces.semantics: Close after core stops; NULL-safe; no concurrent transaction.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_create
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t locker_core_create(const locker_core_config_t *config, locker_repo_t *repo, locker_device_t *device, locker_publisher_t *publisher, locker_core_t **out);
internal_interfaces.semantics: Dependencies are borrowed; fail with NULL; complete recovery before business readiness.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_start
internal_interfaces.semantics: Start one owner thread; remain RECONCILING until synchronized.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_stop
internal_interfaces.semantics: Stop admission and drain or mark writes; timeout is not cancellation.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_destroy
internal_interfaces.semantics: Only after successful stop and adapter callbacks cease; do not close borrowed dependencies.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_authenticate
internal_interfaces.semantics: Validate current session/user in core; recheck session at command execution.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_create
internal_interfaces.semantics: Allocate unopened context; failure sets NULL.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_close
internal_interfaces.semantics: Stop IO and callbacks; invalidate session without replaying EXECUTE.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_destroy
internal_interfaces.semantics: Free only after close and thread join.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_time_anchor
internal_interfaces.semantics: Capture host request start and response arrival; normalize TIME_ANCHOR every 2 seconds.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_events_create
internal_interfaces.semantics: Create bounded change publisher; failure sets NULL.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_events_destroy
internal_interfaces.semantics: Free after websocket closure and producer stop.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_supervisor_create
internal_interfaces.semantics: Fixed UI target and private IPC; independent restart-limit checkpoint.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_supervisor_destroy
internal_interfaces.semantics: Release after supervisor loop stops; no ledger writes.

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_control_init
internal_interfaces.semantics: Return module-owned static context; unverified board config permits diagnostics only.

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_journal_init
internal_interfaces.semantics: Static context; no automatic format; failed boot checkpoint forbids READY.

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_health_init
internal_interfaces.semantics: Static context; valid task deadlines required; host offline does not stop MCU.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_device_bind_sink
internal_interfaces.semantics: Before open; borrowed sink lives through close; callbacks borrow DTO only for call, receiver must copy; backpressure stops new execution/health until reconciliation.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_http_start
internal_interfaces.prototype: locker_status_t locker_http_start(const locker_http_config_t *config, locker_core_t *core, locker_publisher_t *publisher, locker_http_t **out);
internal_interfaces.semantics: Start HTTPS/WS only; no local presence routes; dependencies borrowed.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_http_stop
internal_interfaces.semantics: Stop admission and join workers; timeout forbids destroy.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_http_destroy
internal_interfaces.semantics: After successful stop; do not release borrowed core/publisher.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_ipc_start
internal_interfaces.semantics: Restricted seqpacket service socket; verify peer credentials; dependencies borrowed.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_ipc_stop
internal_interfaces.semantics: Stop admission and join workers before destroying core.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_ipc_destroy
internal_interfaces.semantics: After successful stop; only remove owned socket path.

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_journal_bind_sink
internal_interfaces.semantics: Before storage task starts; borrowed static sink; callback queues token/result to Control, never drives GPIO.

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_board_apply_profile
internal_interfaces.semantics: HAL-only private binding; reject unverified pin/polarity/ADC/timer/IO settings, default lock off; no public network configuration.

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_board_set_alarm
internal_interfaces.semantics: Nonblocking LED/buzzer pattern through verified HAL pins; does not drive lock or mutate custody.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_local_maintenance_reconcile
internal_interfaces.semantics: Trusted local admin CLI and current admin session; compare snapshot/epoch/boot/physical revision and ledger; clear only authorized hold, never pulse or hide gaps.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_supervisor_get_health
internal_interfaces.semantics: Read immutable local supervision snapshot; no process action. Restricted health.get RPC exposes this only to the registered service peer.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_apply_supervisor_health
internal_interfaces.semantics: Copy observation into Core queue; only Core updates public projection; stale cache never refreshes sample time.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_get_progress
internal_interfaces.semantics: Nonblocking immutable observation of real Core loop; no queue wait, IO or synthetic progress increment.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_vision_create
internal_interfaces.semantics: Create unopened local adapter; no inference inside Core.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_vision_bind_sink
internal_interfaces.semantics: Bind before open; callbacks borrow DTO only, Core receiver copies; sink lives until successful close.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_vision_open
internal_interfaces.semantics: Start bounded IO/HELLO; local worker can be unavailable without blocking Core.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_vision_submit
internal_interfaces.semantics: Validate and copy one persisted capture request to bounded queue; QUEUED is not evidence.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_vision_get_status
internal_interfaces.semantics: Nonblocking cached raw worker observation; source time never refreshed by reads.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_vision_close
internal_interfaces.semantics: Stop IO, invalidate captures and join callbacks; timeout forbids destroy, never replay requests.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_vision_destroy
internal_interfaces.semantics: After successful close and Core producer stop only.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_bind_vision
internal_interfaces.semantics: Before Core start; borrowed adapter lives until Core stop and all callbacks cease.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_apply_vision_result
internal_interfaces.semantics: Copy validated raw result into Core queue; Core revalidates correlation, clocks, guards and commits evidence; no worker verdict trusted.

internal_interfaces.name: locker_core_apply_vision_status
internal_interfaces.semantics: Copy source worker observation into Core queue; unknown/stale in REQUIRED fails closed, never synthetic READY.

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_control_bind_sink
internal_interfaces.semantics: Bind before tasks start. Async reply preserves copied session/request_no/type; callback queues to Communication, never GPIO; dependencies static until tasks stop.

internal_interfaces.name: mcu_journal_control
internal_interfaces.semantics: Bounded queue RECOVER/BARRIER/FINALIZE/RELEASE. Storage owns metadata/checkpoints; control_result returns committed immutable state; no format or watermark rollback.

local_methods.authorization: trusted UI peer UID + current user session + operation owner
trusted service peer; UI fixed target; rate limit
trusted local admin CLI peer + current ADMIN session + verified physical baseline
trusted registered service peer instance; supervisor socket only; read-only
